title: Don't let your shine be dulled.
html:
Welcome to the MondayMotivator.

Good morning, welcome to this week's MondayMotivator!

"When my daughter was small she got the dubious part of the Bethlehem star in a Christmas play. After her first rehearsal she burst through the door with her costume… 'What exactly will you be doing in the play?' I asked her. 'I just stand there and shine,' she told me. I've never forgotten that response."
— Sue Monk Kidd

This week's quote is fantastic, so I only need to write the following:

All of us have the ability to shine and when we do, we allow others to do the same.

So no matter what you do this week, do it well and shine: your audience awaits.

Glenn 'The Supernova' Edley
